fact: The Justice Ministry undersecretary said on 10 August 2026 that, with the Ministry of Digital Transformation and Communications, it has prepared a draft Cybersecurity Regulation Law 2026, among other digital bills.
title: وكيل وزارة العدل: الذكاء الاصطناعي والتحول الرقمي آفاق جديدة لتطوير المنظومة العدلية
